_: EXAMPLE rules for tv_risk_guard, shaped like the owner's account layer (spec note 13, part 1.7). COPY this file, put YOUR own numbers in the copy and point Settings -> «Правила риска (JSON)» at it. The app ships no thresholds of its own and never reads this file unless you select it.

risk_per_r._: 1R = 1 % of the account, as the spec states. Set to null and any R <-> money conversion reports 'unknown' instead of guessing.

max_losses_per_day._: E3 — one stop a day: max is the largest count still ALLOWED, so 0 stops the day after the first loss

max_trades_per_week._: E6 — the course expects 1–2 a week

floor_buffer._: E2 — room left above the prop floor; the floor itself comes from the account block in the workflow yaml

idle._: E10 — the prop closes an account after 30 days without a trade
